# Design attribution

The portfolio's layout and CSS adapt the typography, framed grid, and footer patterns of [Brutalistfolio](https://github.com/steelzzeu/brutalistfolio) by Suf Khatib / Steelzz Development, distributed under the MIT License. The original notice is retained in `brutalistfolio-LICENSE.txt`.

The content, Jekyll templates, pure black/white palette, and reduced interaction set are specific to this site.

Display headings use [Rubik Glitch](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/rubikglitch), served locally. Its SIL Open Font License and copyright notice are included in `assets/fonts/RubikGlitch-OFL.txt`.

Body and interface text use [Iceland](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/iceland), served locally. Its SIL Open Font License and copyright notice are included in `assets/fonts/Iceland-OFL.txt`.

The homepage name animation adapts demo 3 of [Text Repetition Effect](https://github.com/codrops/TextRepetitionEffect) by Manoela Ilic / Codrops. It preserves the nine layers, outlined duplicates, 14% vertical displacement steps, and staggered fading. This adaptation displays the name on two lines in black over the existing page background. It starts flat at the page top, expands as the user scrolls down, and collapses when scrolling back up, without autoplay. The MIT notice is retained in `text-repetition-effect-LICENSE.txt`.

The name uses [Archivo Black](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/archivoblack), served locally. Its SIL Open Font License and copyright notice are included in `assets/fonts/ArchivoBlack-OFL.txt`. Only the homepage loads the animation script; no graphics library or npm build is required.
